newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mostly fall, mogas slips $2.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mostly fall, mogas slips $2.

text.p: European oil products mostly eased slightly on Friday in thin trading due to the Assumption Day holiday in many countries.
Gasoline slipped $2 a tonne with offers between $228 and $230 but no bids. September swaps asked $202.50 and October $192.50 some $2.50 below Thursday levels.
Naphtha fell $1 a tonne to $189 for September swaps but talk was subdued. IPE gas oil eased $1.75 a tonne to $172 in early trading but Rotterdam barges were unchanged at parity to the screen.
Heavy fuel was steady. High sulphur barges talked $96.50 for prompt loading and September swaps were unchanged at $95.75.
